prompt: A close friend has cancelled plans at the last minute three times in a row. You value them but are starting to feel devalued. What is the healthiest next step?

options.text: Tell them calmly about the pattern and how it lands, ask what is going on for them, and agree how you will plan differently if their life is hectic right now
Cancel on them at the last minute next time so they feel it too
Stop inviting them without any explanation and let the friendship fade silently
Say it is fine every time while resentment quietly builds up

explanation: A calm conversation about the pattern gives your friend information and a chance to respond, whether the cause is overwhelm or thoughtlessness. Revenge cancelling, silent fading, and pretending it is fine all let the problem grow.
